defects.evidence: Avoid phrases such as: ... 'Responsible for...' ... They either sound passive, generic, exaggerated, or lack enough context.
What does 'model performance' mean—accuracy, F1, precision, recall, latency? What was the baseline and evaluation set?
Unless that is literally accurate, revise it to describe your actual ownership and scope.
These two Mobility bullets describe the same work: ... Keep the quantified version and delete the second one.
Delete this bullet entirely: > Leveraged cutting-edge AI synergies... It is generic, contains no evidence
Avoid phrases such as: ... 'I worked on...' ... Lead with an action and explain the technical work and measurable result.
Your roles should be reverse chronological... Currently, the older role appears first.
main issues are ordering, duplicated claims, inconsistent tense, vague wording
